DZA.note: Interview says the strategy's fifth pillar covers regulation, but states no draft rule, rule in force or authority on AI harms.
No government body's use of an AI system is stated; only plans to digitise public services.
Priority sectors are named as strategy aims; no sectoral AI tool is stated as piloted or in service.

facts.fact: The president of the national AI scientific council says the first version of the national AI strategy, built on six pillars, has just been made public.

The national AI scientific council, created on 26 June 2023 with 28 experts under the higher education and knowledge economy ministries, is said by its president to play a central role in implementing the strategy.

systems.owner: Ministries of higher education and of knowledge economy

DZA.note: Computing centres and a national AI research centre are stated as plans or pillars; nothing built or in service.
A planned AI research centre is not a local institution researching or publishing on digital policy.
Only a pillar on support mechanisms for local startups; no startup law, labelling or fund stated.
Ambition to make Algeria a technology hub is stated; no hub, incubator or park is described.
